title: GraphitiEpisodeSourceV1
description: Memory-owned Graphiti episode source (iris_memory#11): the deterministic, Context-owned unit of ordered ingestion into Graphiti.add_episode. Carries source/episode identity inputs, ordered Context semantic provenance, target group, canonical content, temporal metadata and derivation/anti-echo provenance. Never exposes Graphiti SDK objects, Neo4j records, embeddings or internal graph UUIDs.

episodeSourceHash.description: Deterministic canonical hash of THIS episode source (identity + provenance + content). Re-hashed by the Memory on acceptance; a changed provenance/content is a different payload.

episodeId.description: Memory-owned deterministic episode identity (stable across replay; NOT a Graphiti/Neo4j internal id).

lineageId.description: The identity-level Context lineage this episode's semantic units belong to.

sourceUnitIds.description: Ordered Context unit ids (contextSeq order) that constitute this episode's semantic basis.

canonicalContent.description: Canonical episode body required for Graphiti episode ingestion (ordered message content).

targetGroupId.description: Target group / partition identity for the accepted Graphiti projection.

isDerivedOnly.description: True when the episode contains NO new observation truth (recalled/derived/anti-echo material) — it must not be treated as new observation evidence.
